title: Blocking Smell
statement: Implement `solve(call)`. Return `unsafe` for `time.sleep`, `requests`, and `open`. Return `safe` for `asyncio.sleep` and `httpx-async`. Any other call returns `unknown`.
constraints: Blocking calls are unsafe on the loop
hints: Do not mark requests as safe.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: The event loop runs coroutines cooperatively.

editorial: The event loop runs coroutines cooperatively. time.sleep and a synchronous HTTP library hold the thread, so every other task waits. asyncio.sleep yields. An async HTTP client yields on I/O. The classification is the review comment.
